title: Grab and Move Resize stops across multiple monitors.

judgment.rationale: The supplied multi-monitor scenario is actionable for a maintainer, but its intermittent recovery after a scale reset makes the cause uncertain.
evidence: On 0.99.1 resizing can stop at a monitor boundary on a setup reported as 150% and 100% scaling; returning to those scales after changing them temporarily made it work.
The reporter supplied a PowerToys report ZIP and described a partial or stalled resize.

Pinned Grab and Move resolves an interaction target and applies pointer deltas to a resize rectangle: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The supplied multi-monitor scenario is actionable for a maintainer, but its intermittent recovery after a scale reset makes the cause uncertain.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate resizing across mixed-scale monitors
proposed_fixes.root_cause: DPI transitions or monitor geometry may interact with the stored resize state, but the scale reset behavior means a specific cause is not established.
plan: Reproduce with the reported multi-monitor arrangement, mixed scaling, and then the scale-reset sequence.
Compare pointer coordinates, requested rectangle and actual window rectangle across the boundary; identify the first divergence.
Correct only the confirmed coordinate or state transition and add a multi-monitor regression for the affected geometry.
verification: The resize continues smoothly across both monitor directions at mixed scaling; single-monitor resize remains unchanged.

reproduce.title: Resize across mixed-DPI displays
prerequisites: Two or more monitors with 150% and 100% scaling
setup: Arrange adjacent monitors and enable Grab and Move resize.
steps: Drag the cursor across the monitor boundary and back.
Repeat after setting equal scaling and then restoring mixed scaling.
reproduce.expected_result: Resizing follows the pointer across the boundary without stopping.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Prepare adjacent displays or a suitable multi-monitor test environment with 150% and 100% scaling.
